instruction.text: Find the adverbial phrase in the sentence below and write it at the beginning of the sentence. Don’t forget the comma and capital letter.

atoms.a: These are some jars on the shelf.
Joe and his friends explored the spooky forest bravely.
atoms.b: ((Bravely,)) Joe and his friends explored the spooky forest.

atoms.a: Lacey visits her grandma twice a week.
Frankie eats cereal in the morning.

instruction.text: Read the story below and choose the fronted adverbial that would fit best in the gap.

atoms.b: ((++Last_week Suddenly On_the_roof)), Maisy went on a camping holiday.
((++Sometimes Anxiously Upstairs)), she camps with her dad, but she went with her friends this time.
((++Unfortunately Last_year As_quick_as_they_could)), her friends forgot to bring any food.
((++Luckily Weekly Tomorrow)), Maisy had seen a supermarket close by, so they started to walk there.
((++By_the_time_they_arrived Fortunately In_the_distance)), the shop had already closed.
((++Across_the_street Sadly Under_the_sea)), the owner saw them and offered to reopen the shop just for them.
((++That_night Monthly Closeby)), they celebrated their luck and toasted marshmallows.
